description: Record that the household PAID a quarter's tax to the IRS or a state agency, as the Taxes page's "I've paid this" does; once the payment covers what is owed, NannyKeeper stops reminding them about it. NannyKeeper never sends the payment: only call this after the user tells you they paid. First call get_quarter_taxes for the same year and quarter. `destination` is "federal" or a state_destinations id from that answer. Send exactly one figure: `expected_amount` when they paid the amount get_quarter_taxes showed (federal.due_now, or that destination's amount_owed), or `amount` with what they actually paid. A state `amount` below what is owed counts as an installment and the reminders continue; if the agency billed exactly that amount and the user says it settles the filing, also send closes_filing true. If the answer is figures_changed, the figure moved since you read it: show the user the new figure and ask before trying again. figure_unavailable, nothing_due or annual_filing_needs_amount mean NannyKeeper will not confirm a figure here: ask the user what they paid and send it as `amount`. already_recorded_different means a different payment is already on file and nothing was recorded: tell the user and ask. already_settled means the user already marked that filing paid; changes are made on the Taxes page. Pass the user's own date as payment_date when you know it; it defaults to today in US Eastern time. Use one new idempotency_key per payment and reuse it only to retry that same payment. already_recorded true means nothing new was written. This tool only ADDS a payment: it cannot change or remove one already recorded (its method, confirmation number, date or amount), and calling it again with amount records a second payment. For a correction, send the user to the Taxes page in NannyKeeper. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

amount.description: What the household actually paid, in dollars to the cent. Send this or expected_amount, never both.

closes_filing.description: Optional, with amount on a state agency only: the user's figure closes that filing, as "I paid a different amount" on the Taxes page does.

confirmation_number.description: Optional. The confirmation number the IRS or agency gave them.

destination.description: "federal", or a state_destinations id from get_quarter_taxes, for example MD-UI.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

expected_amount.description: Paid as shown: the dollar figure get_quarter_taxes returned for this destination. Send this or amount, never both.

idempotency_key.description: A new unique string (a UUID) for this payment. Reuse it only to retry the same payment after an error.

notes.description: Optional. A note to keep with the payment.

payment_date.description: Optional. The day they paid, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in US Eastern time.

payment_method.description: Optional. How they paid: eftps or direct_pay for the IRS, state_portal or carrier_portal for a state.

name: record_tax_payment
